The '''LPL 2014 Spring''' was the opening split of the 2014 [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 22 February to 25 May 2014 in Shanghai. Eight teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs bracket. Six teams entered from the [[LPL/2013/Summer|2013 Summer]] split, while two—[[Energy Pacemaker]] and [[LGD Gaming]]—qualified through the [[LPL/2014/Spring/Promotion|LPL Spring Promotion]]. During the offseason, [[EDward Gaming]] acquired the LPL slot of [[LMQ]]. The top two teams advanced to the [[LPL/2014/Regional Finals|Regional Finals]], while the bottom two were relegated to the [[LSPL/2014/Summer|LSPL Summer]] split.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}}
*** A 2-0 victory gives the winning team 3 points
*** A 1-1 tie gives both teams 1 point
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th and 6th place''}} qualify for [[LPL/2014/Summer|Summer season]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''7th and 8th place''}} are relegated to [[LSPL/2014/Summer|LSPL]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
